what: MAV `round-start-s` under `plan-review/round-N/` is wiped by `_snapshot_round_dir` before SKILL deferred timing
scenario_or_breakage: Plan persists `round-start-s` in the round dir and defers `record-plan-review-round-timing.sh` to `skills/design/SKILL.md`, but the MAV branch immediately calls `_snapshot_terminal_exit_preserving_status`, whose `_snapshot_round_dir` deletes every `dest/*` file except `revise/` before repopulating from session-root allowlist copies; `round-start-s` is not a session-root artifact, so adding it to `design_round_artifact_included` does not preserve it
suggested_fix: Exempt `round-start-s` from the `dest/*` deletion loop (or copy it into `tmp` before wipe), or persist start time outside `plan-review/round-N/` (e.g. `$DESIGN_TMPDIR/plan-review-round-$N-start-s`)
